title: Skein CLI
lead: The `skein` command creates projects, adds pages and modules, manages theme styles, and checks the code. It needs Node 22.18 or later.

run.title: Running it
run.p1: There is nothing to install globally:

create.title: Creating a project
create.p1: Without a directory it asks for the name, the template, the theme style and the optional features. `--theme none` starts a blank theme style of your own in `src/theme/`.
create.basic: React on Vite+ (`vp`) + one theme style.
create.admin: Layout, menu, tabs, KeepAlive, preferences, login, a dashboard and a users CRUD page.
create.query: TanStack Query and a fetch wrapper (`src/lib/http.ts`).
create.i18n: i18next, English and Chinese, each page with its own `locales/`.
create.mock: MSW, each page with its own `mocks/handlers.ts`.
create.auth: Login page, route guard, session store. Needs router, query, i18n.
create.shell: AdminLayout, menu, tabs, KeepAlive, preferences drawer. Needs auth, i18n.
create.mcp: `.mcp.json`: the skein commands as MCP tools for AI agents.
create.preview: `playwright-core` for `skein preview` (uses the Chrome you have).
create.tenant: Pages under their tenant (`/acme/orders`), a tenant switcher next to the logo, and the tenant sent as `X-Tenant-Id` with every request. Needs shell.
create.p2: `admin` turns on `shell` and `mock`. `mcp`, `preview` and `tenant` are off by default; `mcp` and `preview` install their packages only in projects that turn them on.

layout.title: An admin project
layout.p1: An admin project is laid out like this:
layout.p2: Each page registers itself: its route by file, its menu entry by `_meta.ts`, its mocks by `mocks/handlers.ts`. Adding a page never edits an existing file.

pages.title: Pages and modules
pages.p1: `--from` reads one resource of an OpenAPI 3 document (JSON or YAML) and writes a list with filters, create, edit and delete, typed, with mocks, plus a detail page when the document reads one item (`GET /orders/{id}`). Pick the resource with `--resource /orders` when there are several.

theme-commands.title: Theme styles
theme-commands.p1: A basic project imports one theme style in `src/skein.theme.ts`. An admin project lists them in `themeStyles` of `src/settings.ts`; each is its own CSS file, loaded only when picked in the preferences drawer. `vite.config.ts` uses `skeinThemes()` from `@skeinui/themes/vite`, so only the stylesheets of the components the app imports are bundled; a project started with `--theme none` gets it from `theme use` / `theme add`, which install `@skeinui/themes`. See [Theming](/theming).

tools.title: Docs and checks
tools.docs: What a component is for, its props and allowed values, examples. `--search <words>` finds components.
tools.check: Type errors with hints, missing translations, hard-coded colours, theme coverage.
tools.preview: Opens the page in Chrome (signed in) and reports errors, failed requests, a blank page, and a screenshot.
tools.init: Writes `.skein.json` for a project that lacks it, detecting its features from its files.
tools.mcp: All of the above, plus `new page`, `theme` and `create`, as MCP tools. See [AI coding agents](/ai).

options.title: Common options
options.p1: Every command takes `--json` (machine-readable output, never asks). Commands that write take `--dry-run` (list what would be written) and only overwrite existing files with `--force`. `skein create` writes `.skein.json` (template, theme style, features), which the other commands read: keep it committed.
